2608.05225.title: Project2Task: Graph-Guided Project-Level Planning for Autonomous Research
2608.05225.paper_summary: Research agents can increasingly search literature, propose hypotheses, generate code, run experiments, and draft manuscripts from a single topic. However, a research project is not merely a larger task: it is a long-horizon agenda that must be advanced through multiple bounded tasks with distinct but related objectives, parallel alternatives, and dependency-aware sequences. Existing single-task systems often treat the project as one oversized task, produce a flat set of vague or overlapping tasks, or leave task boundaries and execution order to manual coordination. We introduce Project2Task, a graph-guided project-level planning layer for autonomous research. Given a project brief, it represents candidate contributions as innovation atoms and organizes them in a directed lineage graph. A lightweight Bernoulli block-model objective selects among horizontal, vertical, and hybrid portfolio decompositions. Project2Task then generates bounded tasks with explicit contribution ownership, repairs overlaps and missing execution fields, and emits dependency-aware task contracts that specify objectives, inputs, expected artifacts, evaluation requirements, boundary constraints, dependencies, and execution order. The contracts are independent of any particular downstream research executor and support integration of task outputs into a coherent project-level result. On a benchmark of ten project briefs yielding roughly 30 tasks, manuscript-based portfolio evaluation gives Project2Task an average quality score of 7.15, compared with 4.58 for the Brief Baseline and 5.31 for the Topic-only Setting. Integrating its contracts with AutoResearchClaw increases average downstream task accuracy from 0.536 to 0.759. These results demonstrate the value of explicit project-to-task planning for producing coherent, non-redundant, and executable research-task portfolios.
2608.05225.paper_summary_zh: 研究代理人越來越能夠從單一主題中搜尋文獻、提出假設、生成代碼、進行實驗並撰寫手稿。<lb/>然而，研究項目不僅僅是一個更大的任務：它是一個長期的議程，必須通過多個有界任務來推進，這些任務具有不同但相關的目標、平行的替代方案和依賴關係意識的序列。<lb/>現有的單一任務系統通常將項目視為一個過大的任務，產生一組模糊或重疊的任務，或將任務邊界和執行順序留給手動協調。<lb/>我們介紹了Project2Task，一個圖形引導的項目級計劃層，用於自主研究。<lb/>給定一個項目簡介，它將候選貢獻表示為創新原子，並將它們組織在一個有向系譜圖中。<lb/>一個輕量級的伯努利塊模型目標在水平、垂直和混合投資組合分解之間進行選擇。<lb/>然後，Project2Task生成具有明確貢獻所有權的有界任務，修復重疊和缺失的執行字段，並發出依賴關係意識的任務合同，這些合同指定目標、輸入、預期產物、評估要求、邊界約束、依賴關係和執行順序。<lb/>這些合同獨立於任何特定的下游研究執行者，並支持將任務輸出整合成一致的項目級結果。<lb/>在一個基準測試中，十個項目簡介產生大約30個任務，基於手稿的投資組合評估使Project2Task的平均質量得分為7.15，而簡介基線為4.58，僅主題設置為5.31。<lb/>將其合同與AutoResearchClaw集成，將平均下游任務準確率從0.536提高到0.759。<lb/>這些結果展示了明確的項目到任務計劃在產生一致的、非冗餘的和可執行的研究任務投資組合中的價值。
